answer: The canyon schedule is applied in wharf and quartz reveals each instalment. A payout is split thus 36% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2759 identities would post 3861 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
